notices.title: Struck_off_Notice 45_12.11.26
notices.author: administrator
notices.body: GNDEC has posted a struck-off notice. The attached official document may contain student names, college and university roll numbers, parent names, and individual reasons. Compass does not copy those personal details; open the source if you need to check your own record.
notices.privacyNote: Student-identifying information may be present in the official attachment. Compass does not use your saved profile to search or disclose it.
